title: ClusterVAD: Threshold-Free Unsupervised Voice Activity Detection with Pre-Trained Neural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.33059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voice activity detection (VAD) is one of the first steps in speech processing pipelines, from transcription and diarization to speech language models. Supervised detectors need labelled data and inherit the domain and annotation conventions of their training corpora. Existing unsupervised detectors rely on hand-crafted acoustic features which cannot benefit from data and degrade in far-field, noisy or atypical speech. We propose ClusterVAD, an unsupervised VAD built on frozen speech foundation model representations. Fitted once on a small set of untranscribed speech, it clusters the representations and labels each cluster as speech or non-speech with sonority, an acoustic measure. At inference, a frame-level speech probability is computed from the cluster assignments, and a two-state hidden Markov model fitted to each recording enables threshold-free detection. translated_title: ClusterVAD：基于预训练神经表示的无阈值无监督语音活动检测
translated_abstract: 语音活动检测（VAD）是语音处理流水线中的首要步骤之一，其应用涵盖从转录、说话人分离到语音语言模型。有监督检测器需要标注数据，并继承了其训练语料库的领域特性和标注惯例。现有的无监督检测器则依赖手工设计的声学特征，这些特征无法从数据中获益，并且在远场、噪声或非典型语音条件下性能会下降。我们提出了ClusterVAD，一种构建在冻结的语音基础模型表示之上的无监督VAD方法。它只需在少量未转录语音上拟合一次，即可对这些表示进行聚类，并利用响度（sonority，一种声学度量）将每个聚类标注为语音或非语音。在推理阶段，通过聚类分配计算帧级语音概率，并为每条录音拟合一个两状态隐马尔可夫模型，从而实现无需设定阈值的检测。在涵盖会议、远场和噪声录音的多个基准测试上……
tldr: 提出了ClusterVAD，一种基于冻结语音基础模型表示的无监督语音活动检测方法，通过对表示进行聚类并用响度标注语音/非语音聚类，结合逐录音拟合的隐马尔可夫模型，实现了无需阈值设定且在会议、远场和噪声等场景下表现稳健的检测。
en_tdlr: ClusterVAD is a threshold-free unsupervised voice activity detection method that clusters frozen speech foundation model representations, labels each cluster as speech or non-speech using sonority, and applies a per-recording two-state hidden Markov model for robust detection across meetings, far-field and noisy recordings.
